observed_stderr: argparse rejected Runner-supplied positional package_root and entrypoint arguments
root_cause: Runner v1.0.5 launcher supplies two positional arguments to Python entrypoints. The v0.1 Stage E analyzer used strict argparse without declaring these launcher arguments.

correction.approach: Explicitly declare exactly two optional Runner positional arguments and fail closed unless entrypoint equals current script and package root is an ancestor. Do not use parse_known_args.
